result.instructions: Tools for Channable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List marketplace orders waiting for shipment."; "Show returns received this week."; "Check the latest stock updates for a project.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Channable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run channable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run channable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run channable_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. channable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: channable_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the marketplace orders of a project, newest first. Filters combine with AND; dates are read as UTC. Paged: pass next_offset as offset (total is the size of the page, not of all orders). Reply: orders, error_count (orders with an error), count, next_offset. GET /v2/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

status.description: Only orders in one of these statuses: shipped, not_shipped, waiting, cancelled, processing, pending_shipment, pending_cancellation, cancellation_request, awaiting_confirmation, partial, manual.

errors.description: true = only orders with an error.

start_date.description: Orders created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601, UTC).

end_date.description: Orders created on or before this date.

retrieved_at_start.description: Orders retrieved from the marketplace on or after this date.

retrieved_at_end.description: Orders retrieved from the marketplace on or before this date.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: channable_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: One order with its customer, addresses, items, status, fulfillments and event log. order_id is the Channable order id (the id field from channable_list_orders). GET /v2/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders/{order_id}.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

tools.name: channable_ship_order
tools.title: Mark an order as shipped
tools.description: Set an order to shipped, with tracking data. Give transporter as a Channable transporter code (channable_list_transporters lists them) and tracking_code. Pass order_item_ids to ship only some items (the order then becomes partial; repeat with the other items later); omit it to ship the whole order. Spartoo and Veepee do not support partial shipments. POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders/{order_id}/shipment. Channable passes this change on to the marketplace. It cannot be undone through this API and the call is never retried; if it times out, check the order in Channable before trying again.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

transporter.description: Channable transporter code, e.g. POSTNL, DHL, DPD.

tracking_code.description: Track and trace code of the parcel.

return_transporter.description: Transporter code for the return label, if the marketplace asks for it.

return_tracking_code.description: Track and trace code of the return label.

delivery_bill_id.description: Delivery bill id, if the marketplace asks for it.

order_item_ids.description: Only these order items are shipped (partial shipment). Omit to ship all.

tools.name: channable_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Seller-side cancellation: set an order to cancelled. Pass order_item_ids to cancel only some items (the order then becomes partial); omit it to cancel the whole order. Amazon, Cdiscount and Spartoo do not support partial cancellations. A buyer-side cancellation must be confirmed in the marketplace seller account instead. POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders/{order_id}/cancel. Channable passes this change on to the marketplace. It cannot be undone through this API and the call is never retried; if it times out, check the order in Channable before trying again.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

order_item_ids.description: Only these order items are cancelled (partial cancellation). Omit to cancel all.

tools.name: channable_mark_order_manual
tools.title: Mark an order as handled manually
tools.description: Tell Channable that you handle this order yourself: Channable takes no further action on it (no status updates to the marketplace). POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders/{order_id}/manual. Channable passes this change on to the marketplace. It cannot be undone through this API and the call is never retried; if it times out, check the order in Channable before trying again.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

annotations.title: Mark an order as handled manually

tools.name: channable_create_return
tools.title: Create a return for an order
tools.description: Manually create a return on the marketplace for products of an order. Only Fruugo, Otto, Veepee and Zalando support this. products lists the product ids (the item id of the order), the quantity and optionally accepted or rejected. POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders/{order_id}/return. Channable passes this change on to the marketplace. It cannot be undone through this API and the call is never retried; if it times out, check the order in Channable before trying again.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

id.description: Product id as in the order item.

status.description: accepted or rejected (omit for the marketplace default).

annotations.title: Create a return for an order

tools.name: channable_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: List the returns of a project, newest first. Dates are read as UTC. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. Reply: returns, error_count, count, next_offset. GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/returns.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

errors.description: true = only returns with an error.

start_date.description: Returns created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO 8601, UTC).

end_date.description: Returns created on or before this date.

retrieved_at_start.description: Returns retrieved on or after this date.

retrieved_at_end.description: Returns retrieved on or before this date.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: channable_get_return
tools.title: Get a return
tools.description: One return with its item, reason, customer, status and log. return_id is the id field from channable_list_returns. GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/returns/{return_id}.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

tools.name: channable_update_return_status
tools.title: Set the status of a return
tools.description: Set the status of a return: accepted, rejected, repaired, keeps, exchanged, cancelled. Depending on the status the customer does or does not get their money back (accepted and cancelled differ from rejected). POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/returns/{return_id}/status. Channable passes this change on to the marketplace. It cannot be undone through this API and the call is never retried; if it times out, check the order in Channable before trying again.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

annotations.title: Set the status of a return

tools.name: channable_list_stock_updates
tools.title: List posted stock updates
tools.description: List the offers (product stock updates) that were posted to a project, newest first: id, stock, price, title, GTIN. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. Reply: offers, count, next_offset. GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/offers.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

start_date.description: Offers created on or after this date (UTC).

end_date.description: Offers created on or before this date.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: channable_update_stock
tools.title: Update product stock on all marketplaces
tools.description: Set the stock of up to 50 offers. Each item is the offer id as the marketplaces know it, plus the WHOLE new stock value (not a delta). Channable passes the new stock to every marketplace of the project, which changes what customers can buy. POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/stock_updates. Channable passes this change on to the marketplace. It cannot be undone through this API and the call is never retried; if it times out, check the order in Channable before trying again.

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

id.description: Offer id (the id of the product in your feed / on the marketplace).

stock.description: The whole new stock value, not a delta.

annotations.title: Update product stock on all marketplaces

tools.name: channable_get_order_statistics
tools.title: Get order statistics
tools.description: Order statistics of a project for a time frame: orders, ordered products, marketplace commission, shipping costs, revenue and daily revenue, per order connection and in total. Pass order_config_id (the order_config_id field of an order) for one order connection only. GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/statistics/orders[/{order_config_id}].

project_id.description: Channable project id (Project settings). Default: the project chosen at login.

order_config_id.description: Only this order connection (the order_config_id of an order).

tools.name: channable_list_transporters
tools.title: List transporter codes
tools.description: Channable transporter codes for shipping updates. With no argument: all codes and labels (transporter_code is what channable_ship_order expects). With transporter_code: the marketplace-specific carriers behind that code. With channel (a marketplace such as bol, amazon, ebay): the carriers that marketplace supports. Give at most one of the two. GET /v1/transporters/all | /transporter/{code} | /channel/{channel}.

transporter_code.description: A Channable transporter code, e.g. DHL.

channel.description: A marketplace name, lowercase, e.g. bol, amazon, ebay, otto.
